sentences.text: Fortunguavis is an extinct monotypic genus within the enantiornithean theropods.
The genus Fortunguavis was described by Wang and colleagues in 2014.
The extreme curvature of its foot claws suggests that Fortunguavis was highly specialized for climbing.
This animal lived during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous epoch, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
